reportedSymptom: The asynchronous request path is under representative loopback load and remains responsive.
groundTruth: The fixed endpoint awaits loopback I/O asynchronously and does not block ThreadPool workers.

workload.setup: Launch a fresh Release BadCodeSample process over loopback.
workload.activation: Start overlapping GET /sync-over-async-fixed?n=40&delaySeconds=3 requests after the EventCounter session startup delay.
workload.cleanup: Cancel outstanding requests and terminate the sample process tree.

misleadingSignals: Concurrent request latency alone can resemble starvation even when asynchronous waits are not consuming worker threads.
